message_markdown:
Good morning, Leonard. Echo Morning Briefing — Friday, May 15, 2026.

**System Health: Recovered.** Overnight crash loop (120 restarts, 23-min cycle) resolved by Sentinel agent at 04:52 PT. Autoloop stable with 0 restarts. Permanent code patch approved but unapplied.

**Gateway: Stable.** 2d 11h uptime, 0 restarts, 209M RAM.

**Public Services: Operational.** ngrok healthz OK — dashboard, SMS, LINE all healthy.

**Items needing attention:**
- Telegram unreachable 23+ hours
- Agent memory at 95% capacity (silent write failures)
- MCP server port 8090 not listening

**Pipeline:** 8/10 agents completed. Video script ready but rendering blocked on Historian gate + missing assets.

I can prioritize any remaining action items. What would you like to tackle first?
public_summary: Echo System 3.0 autonomous infrastructure recovered from an overnight crash loop. Sentinel agent detected and corrected data corruption; loop stabilized within minutes. Public-facing services operational. Four medium-priority items remain: latent code bug, Telegram offline, MCP watchdog missing, memory near capacity. Video production pipeline staged but blocked on asset verification.
